description: Summarizes supplied interview notes with source-linked observations and preserved disagreements. Use when synthesizing anonymized interviews.
scope: Summarize anonymized interview notes using only supplied evidence.
steps: Group observations and cite their excerpt IDs.
Retain opposing preferences as separate source-linked observations.
checks: Every observation cites a supplied excerpt ID.
No invented participant facts or motivations.
Disagreement is not converted into consensus.
pitfalls: Do not present an interpretation as a direct observation.
A majority preference does not erase a minority preference.

validation.case: Fictional I5 prefers a guided setup; I6 prefers skipping setup.
validation.actual: Guided setup preferred [I5]; skipping setup preferred [I6]. Preferences disagree.
